description: This file defines the AzureTableStorageClusteringProviderBuilder class, which implements builder interfaces for configuring Azure storage clustering providers for Orleans Silo and Client. It includes methods to set up Azure Table Storage options based on configuration settings, including connection strings, service keys, and table names.

classes.name: AzureTableStorageClusteringProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class that configures Azure Table Storage clustering providers for Orleans Silo and Client, using configuration settings to set up TableServiceClient instances and table names.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the Orleans Silo builder with Azure Storage clustering options based on provided configuration section.
